data.bottom_line: You can trigger dangerous avalanches near and above treeline on wind-loaded slopes steeper than about 35 degrees. The most dangerous slopes face the north half of the compass. Winds will be strong enough this weekend to move snow above treeline. Give slopes a wide berth where you find recently drifted snow. You can trigger these drifts from adjacent terrain or low-angled slopes. Seek out wind-sheltered areas and slopes below treeline for safer travel options.
